system.description:
You gain the [Nature] tag. Gain + [SR × 4] to the physical damage rolls you do. 

(Effect): You gain [Barrier: [STR base]]. 
(CR 11): Becomes + [SR × 5] instead of + [SR × 4]. 
(CR 21): + [SR × 7].

A special skill that summons and uses the ancestral spirit Forest Bear, which embodies the magnificence of nature and the calmness of the forest. A raging guardian, the Forest Bear protects you and slays your foes.
